hypotheses.justification: The statement only needs `L` and `[Field L]`, which are needed to form `LaurentSeries L` and `algebraMap L (LaurentSeries L)`. `CharZero L` is instance-implicit and mentions only `L`, so it is pulled in as an argument. The proof is `rw [algebraMap_laurentSeries_eq_single, HahnSeries.C_apply]`. The lemma `ModularCurve.algebraMap_laurentSeries_eq_single` (Definitions/Def_ModularCurve_LaurentCoeff.lean, line 66) is stated under only `variable (L : Type*) [Field L]`, so it needs no characteristic assumption. `HahnSeries.C_apply` is a general lemma about the ring hom `C`. So the theorem holds and is provable for every field `L`, and `CharZero L` can be removed with `omit [CharZero L] in`.
